description: Hourly wind forecast for the next 1-48 hours at any point: mean wind speed in mph, km/h, knots and m/s, the compass direction it blows from, and the Beaufort force with its name (for example "fresh breeze"). For cycling, sailing, drone flying, kite flying or securing garden furniture. Source: MET Norway Locationforecast 2.0. Speeds are 10-minute mean winds at 10 m; gusts are included only where MET Norway provides them. Needs lat and lon: for a UK place name or postcode, get coordinates from geocode or postcode_lookup first. (cost: 1 credit)

hours.description: integer, optional, how many hours ahead from the current hour (1-48), default 24

lat.description: number, required, latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90)

lon.description: number, required, longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180)

name: wind_forecast
